prompt: I'm running an employee wellness pilot program and need help getting a week's worth of mood journal entries properly recorded in our local emotion tracking system. I have a rough log file at /workspace/week_log.txt that contains 7 days of notes. Please go through the log, enter each day's notes into the system as proper diary entries, and make sure the entry from 3 days ago gets corrected as described in the notes (the initial entry will be wrong and needs to be updated using the correct content specified in the notes). Once all entries are recorded and corrected, generate a trend analysis report for the last 7 days and save the output to a file called trend_report.txt in /workspace.
